timing_method: Ordinary strict public evolving steps, no profiler. Step timers include public admission, numerical stages, validation and result/history capture. Setup, request construction, diagnostics, progress output and final snapshot are outside step timers. Simulation wall includes loop overhead; work wall includes setup and snapshot but excludes imports and final report writing.
external_process_wall_method: Measured by /usr/bin/time -f process_wall_seconds=%e; includes imports, setup, simulation, snapshot and report writing; seconds rounded to two decimals.
